title: Imperial Council Hall, Topkapi Palace
visualBrief: Imperial Council Hall (Kubbealti) with attached L-shaped portico, named OSM way103907772 and roof way335402671, fourth authored member of18 Topkapi Palace structures. Low cream hall, broad hipped lead portico cap, working courtyard and southwest-return pointed arcades, pale marble shafts with stepped capitals/gold collars, recessed large pointed gold-toned window screens and lower open arched doors into enclosed halls. Three compact domed bays are an explicit footprint-led roof reconstruction; exact inaccessible dome/room inventory and profiles remain approximate. Shared neutral rosette screening replaces bespoke lattice artwork. Tower of Justice, adjacent Outer Treasury, Harem and other independent buildings remain host context. No copied painted ceiling scenes, inscriptions/tughra, furniture or visitors.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Individual named OSM way103907772/native35184475996604, within Topkapi Palace site Q170495. The approximately26.7x11.6m four-corner hall/portico outline fixes dimensions and location. Site QID is retained with the exact mapped member; no unverified independent QID is invented. Native+X east/+Z south at heading0. Internal+X follows the long facade north-northeast; internal+Z faces the Second Courtyard east-southeast. The Outer Treasury and Tower of Justice have independent map identities and are excluded. The attached layer1 L-shaped portico is separately mapped as way335402671/native35184707491503. It wraps the Council Hall on its courtyard and southwest sides, corresponds to the photographed open portico, and belongs to this physical member. It is included in the source and replacement mask; adjacent Tower of Justice and Treasury remain independent.
